scripts.backup: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (!(Test-Path 'backups')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path 'backups' | Out-Null }; $f = 'backups/spy-db-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm') + '.sql'; wrangler d1 export spy-db --remote --output $f; Write-Output ('Saved: ' + $f)"
scripts.dbstats: wrangler d1 execute spy-db --remote --command "SELECT 'messages' AS t, COUNT(*) AS c FROM messages UNION ALL SELECT 'users', COUNT(*) FROM users UNION ALL SELECT 'authorized_users', COUNT(*) FROM authorized_users UNION ALL SELECT 'connections', COUNT(*) FROM connections"
